tool.name: variantstring
tool.description: Utilities for working with variant string format
tool.command: Rscript '${__tool_directory__}/variantstring_wrapper.R' '$op_conditional.operation' '$input_file' '$output_file' '$variant_column' #if str($has_header) == "true": TRUE #else: FALSE #end if #if str($op_conditional.operation) == "compare_variant_string" or str($op_conditional.operation) == "compare_position_string": '$op_conditional.target_string' #else: NA #end if #if str($op_conditional.operation) == "subset_position": '$op_conditional.position_string' #else: NA #end if #if str($op_conditional.operation) == "overlay_variant": '$op_conditional.second_input_file' '$op_conditional.second_variant_column' #else: NA 1 #end if

param.name: input_file
param.label: Input tabular file
param.help: Tabular file containing variant strings (one per row)

param.name: has_header
param.label: Input file has a header row
param.help: When checked, the first row of the input file is treated as a header and skipped. This applies to both input files for the overlay operation.

param.name: operation
param.label: Operation
param.help: Choose which variantstring function to apply
param.option: Check variant string — Validate variant strings
Check position string — Validate position strings
Variant to long — Expand variant strings to long-form table
Position from variant string — Strip amino acids to get position strings
Subset position — Subset variant strings to specified positions
Compare variant string — Check if target genotype is present in comparison strings
Compare position string — Check if target positions are covered in comparison strings
Get component variants — Resolve component genotypes from mixed calls
Extract single-locus variants — Decompose multi-locus variant strings
Order variant string — Canonical sorting of variant strings
Drop read counts — Remove read count information from variant strings
Count hets — Count phased and unphased heterozygous loci
Overlay variant — Overlay one variant string onto another

param.name: position_string
param.label: Position string
param.help: Position string specifying which gene/position combinations to retain (e.g. dhps:437)

validator.message: Only valid position string characters are allowed (letters, digits, :, _, ;, ., -)

param.name: target_string
param.label: Target variant string
param.help: Target variant string to search for in comparison strings. Cannot contain heterozygous calls (e.g. dhps:437:G)

validator.message: Only valid variant string characters are allowed (letters, digits, :, _, /, |, ;, ., -)

param.name: target_string
param.label: Target position string
param.help: Target position string to search for in comparison strings (e.g. dhps:437_540)

validator.message: Only valid position string characters are allowed (letters, digits, :, _, ;, ., -)

param.name: second_input_file
param.label: Second input tabular file
param.help: Second tabular file for overlay_variant. Must have the same number of rows as the first file (aligned by row index).

param.name: second_variant_column
param.label: Second file variant column
param.help: Column number (1-based) containing variant strings in the second file

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool provides utilities for working with *variant string format*, a compact text format for encoding multi-locus amino-acid genotypes. For example, the string ``pfcrt:72_73:C|S_V|A`` encodes phased heterozygous calls at two codon positions in the *pfcrt* gene.
**Variant string format rules**
1. Gene name, locus, and amino acid are separated by colons: ``pfcrt:72:C`` 2. Multiple loci within a gene are separated by underscores: ``pfcrt:72_73:CV`` 3. Unphased mixed calls use ``/``: ``pfcrt:72:C/S`` 4. Phased mixed calls use ``|``: ``pfcrt:72_73:C|S_V|A`` 5. Multiple genes are separated by semicolons: ``pfcrt:72:C;pfmdr-1:86:Y`` 6. Optional read counts as a fourth element: ``pfcrt:72:C:50``
**Operations**
- **Check variant string**: Validate that strings conform to variant string format. - **Check position string**: Validate position strings (gene + position only). - **Variant to long**: Expand variant strings into a long-form table (one row per allele per locus). - **Position from variant string**: Strip amino acids to produce position strings. - **Subset position**: Subset variant strings to only specified gene/position combinations. - **Compare variant string**: Check if a target genotype is present in each comparison string. Reports match, ambiguous, and proportion (WSGF). - **Compare position string**: Check if target positions are covered in comparison strings. - **Get component variants**: Resolve unambiguous component genotypes from mixed calls. - **Extract single-locus variants**: Decompose multi-locus variant strings into single-locus variants. - **Order variant string**: Canonical sorting of variant strings. - **Drop read counts**: Remove read count information from variant strings. - **Count hets**: Count phased and unphased heterozygous loci. - **Overlay variant**: Combine two variant strings, with the first overwriting at shared positions.
**Input format**
Input is a tabular file with variant strings in a specified column (default: column 1). The "Has header row" option should be checked if the first line of the file is a column name rather than data.
**Output format**
The output is a tabular file. For most operations, the output contains the input variant strings alongside a new result column. For ``variant_to_long``, the output is a long-form table with columns: ``input_row``, ``gene``, ``pos``, ``n_aa``, ``het``, ``phased``, ``aa``, ``read_count``. For ``compare_variant_string``, the output has columns ``match``, ``ambiguous``, and ``prop`` (within-sample genotype frequency). For ``overlay_variant``, the output has columns ``var1``, ``var2``, and ``overlay``.
**Overlay operation note**
The ``overlay_variant`` function takes two vectors of equal length and performs element-wise overlay. Both input files must have the same number of rows, and they are aligned by row index. The "Has header row" setting applies to both files.
